snippet.title: Mingle Prototype - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Find your perfect match in the crowd. Match and merge minglers. Repeat until they're all joined together.

Play free in-browser demo or download for Windows and macOS: https://cookiecrayon.itch.io/mingle
